4266.title: Attachment transport policy differs from session transport
4266.rootCauseOneLine: The attachment client enforces HTTPS or loopback before fetching, while session opening accepts the configured non-loopback HTTP URL.
4266.proposedFix: Decide the supported attachment transport policy before changing the security guard.
4266.caveats: Direct client reproduction with injected transport; no live Kubernetes, browser, or provider run. No safe simple fix because this changes a security boundary.
